# Roles and permissions

Roles are granted per workspace and are additive. Every API route and console action requires one permission (`x-permission` in the OpenAPI definition).

| Role | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `auditor` | Reads everything in the workspace, including the audit log, workflow history and evidence metadata. Never writes. |
| `owner` | Maintains register data (ingestion, import, rollback), runs evaluations, attaches evidence, submits controls for review, generates reports; can be assigned as control owner. |
| `reviewer` | Reviews submitted controls: records review notes, recommends, sends back. |
| `approver` | Everything a reviewer may do, plus approval (never of a control they own, unless self-approval is allowed). |
| `admin` | Manages members, roles, tokens, retention and workspace settings. Not implicitly an approver. |

## Permission matrix

| Permission | auditor | owner | reviewer | approver | admin |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| data.read | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| data.write |   | ✓ |   |   |   |
| evaluation.run |   | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |   |
| evidence.write |   | ✓ |   |   |   |
| workflow.assign |   | ✓ |   |   | ✓ |
| workflow.submit |   | ✓ |   |   |   |
| workflow.review |   |   | ✓ | ✓ |   |
| workflow.approve |   |   |   | ✓ |   |
| report.generate |   | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |   |
| audit.read | ✓ |   |   |   | ✓ |
| members.manage |   |   |   |   | ✓ |
| tokens.own | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| tokens.manage |   |   |   |   | ✓ |
| settings.manage |   |   |   |   | ✓ |
